subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` fail closed for every legacy ownerless session row, or must eligible rows be migrated before exact ownership enforcement?
rationale: The implementation enforces exact ownership safely, but this choice determines whether persisted legacy state and existing plugin workflows stop working after upgrade.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide documented operator recovery or a narrowly scoped repair path for affected legacy state.

options.title: Migrate eligible rows first
options.body: Add a bounded doctor or migration owner that stamps only rows whose plugin ownership can be established safely.

options.title: Preserve ownerless access
options.body: Allow plugin-runtime patches to ownerless rows and retain the weaker isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide documented operator recovery or a narrowly scoped repair path for affected legacy state.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged work most directly introduced and migrated the affected session lifecycle, accessor, and plugin-ownership seams.
